items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Jules Gallet, the clarinet player in that band, sent me a recording.

ctx.x: So they were over there very early.
Yeah, Jules Gallet, the clarinet player in that band, sent me a recording. The last album that they made. I've got it here. Yeah.
I wonder who wrote the notes for that album. Bill Russell and I did. Yeah.
